info.title: Trendyol International Marketplace - Product Integration API
info.description: Trendyol International Marketplace product integration API services for non-TR sellers. Covers product creation (V2), filtering, updating, deletion, archiving, stock-price updating, buybox, unlock, and batch request tracking services.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: Category, attribute, and attribute value services

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Product creation, filtering, deletion, archiving, buybox, and unlock services

get.description: The brandId to be sent in createProduct requests is retrieved using this service. A minimum of 1000 brand records can be retrieved per page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number indicating which page of brands to retrieve

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of brands to include in a single response

get.description: Search brands by name. Note that the search is case-sensitive.

post.description: Used to create brands that are not present in the Trendyol Brand List. The request is sent as form-data instead of a JSON body. The brand name must be sent as text in the "name" field, and the brand images must be sent as files in the "images" field. A minimum of 1 and a maximum of 3 images can be sent.

parameters.name: storeFrontCode
parameters.description: Country code the brand will be created for (TR for Türkiye)

get.description: The categoryId to be sent in createProduct requests is retrieved using this service. The lowest-level (leaf) category ID must be used. The category tree is updated periodically; it is recommended to fetch the latest list on a weekly basis.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Category name filter. Returns categories at every level whose name contains the given keyword.

get.description: The attributes information to be sent in the Product Creation request is retrieved using this service. The allowMultipleAttributeValues field indicates whether multiple values are supported. The lowest-level (leaf) category ID must be used.

parameters.name: required
parameters.description: When true, only required attributes are returned; when false, only non-required attributes are returned. If omitted, all attributes are returned.

get.description: The attribute values information to be sent in the Product Creation request is retrieved using this service.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum number of items per page (max 1000)

post.description: Uploads products to the Trendyol system. In the attribute structure, attributeValueIds (array) or attributeValue (string) is used. The maximum number of items per request is 1,000. listPrice cannot be less than salePrice. The operation is asynchronous; the result should be checked using the returned batchRequestId.

get.description: Returns the basic status information of your product in your Trendyol store.

Lists unapproved (draft) products in your Trendyol store. Includes products pending approval and rejected products. nextPageToken is used when there are more than 10,000 unapproved barcodes. page x size can be at most 10,000.

parameters.name: nextPageToken
parameters.description: Next page token when there are more than 10,000 products

get.description: Lists approved products in your Trendyol store. Returns data in a content-based structure; each content contains a variants array. nextPageToken is used when there are more than 10,000 content items. page x size can be at most 10,000.

parameters.name: nextPageToken
parameters.description: Next page token when there are more than 10,000 content items

get.summary: Product Filtering - Approved Products Stock and Price (filterApprovedProductsInventoryAndPrice)
get.description: Returns only the stock and price information of approved products. nextPageToken is used when there are more than 10,000 approved content items. page x size can be at most 10,000. The stockLastModifiedDate field returns a value only if a stock update has been made for the product; otherwise it returns null.

parameters.name: orderByDirection
parameters.description: Sort direction based on the sellerCreatedDate field. asc sorts from oldest to newest, desc sorts from newest to oldest.

parameters.name: nextPageToken
parameters.description: Next page token when there are more than 10,000 content items

delete.description: Removes products from the Trendyol system. Supports single and bulk product deletion. Products pending approval and approved products that have been archived for more than one day and have not been suspended by Trendyol can be deleted.

put.description: Archives or unarchives products in the Trendyol system. Supports single and bulk product archiving operations. The maximum number of items per request is 1,000.

post.description: Returns the buybox information of products: buybox rank, buybox price, and whether there are multiple sellers. A maximum of 10 barcodes can be sent. Service rate limit is 1000 req/min.

put.description: Unlocks locked products. Products that have been suspended from sale due to low/high pricing, critical price errors, or inability to supply can be unlocked using this service.

post.description: Updates unapproved products in your Trendyol store. The maximum number of items per request is 1,000.

Updates the content information of approved products. Partial update is supported except for attribute values. If any attribute is to be updated, all attributes and their values must be sent. Maximum 1,000 items per request.
Updates the variant information of approved products. All fields except the barcode field can be updated. Partial update is not supported. Maximum 1,000 items.
Updates the delivery information of approved products. All fields except the barcode field can be updated. Maximum 1,000 items.

get.summary: Product Information Update Result Check Service (getUpdateAudits)
get.description: Returns the product review step result for successful requests previously sent to the product information update services. If an update was rejected, the reasons are provided in the rejectReasons field. The content of the updates field varies depending on the update type (type).

post.description: Updates the price and stock information of products that have been transferred to and approved by Trendyol. You cannot send the same request repeatedly for 15 minutes. Maximum 1,000 items, maximum 20,000 stock per product.

get.description: Checks the result of operations obtained via batchRequestId. The status field is checked to determine whether the batch operation has been completed. Batch request results can be viewed up to 4 hours after completion.

Lists the available cargo providers. The returned code values can be sent in the cargoProviders field of product creation and update requests. The list varies by storefront; if the storefrontcode header is not sent, TR is used by default.

basicAuth.description: Basic Authentication - Enter your API Key as the Username and API Secret Key as the Password. These credentials can be obtained from Trendyol Seller Panel > My Account > Integration Information. A User-Agent header is required for all requests (format: "SellerId - IntegratorCompanyName" or "SellerId - SelfIntegration").

storefrontcode.name: storefrontcode
storefrontcode.description: Country code. If not sent, or if TR is sent, the Türkiye storefront is used.

acceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
acceptLanguage.description: Language of the service response. On the TR storefront the response is always returned in Turkish. On other storefronts the values tr, en, ro, ar, and el are supported; en is used when the header is omitted or an unsupported value is sent.

BadRequest.description: Missing or invalid parameter in the URL.

Unauthorized.description: One of supplierID, API Key, or API Secret Key is missing or incorrect.

InternalServerError.description: A temporary error may have occurred. Please wait a few minutes.

name.description: Name of the brand to be created

stockLastModifiedDate.description: Returns null if no stock update has been made for the product

UpdateAuditDetail.description: Update detail. The populated fields vary depending on the value of the type field: changedTitle/existingTitle for TITLE, changedDescription/existingDescription for DESCRIPTION, changedMedias/existingMedias for MEDIA, and changedAttributes/existingAttributes for ATTRIBUTE.

code.description: Cargo provider code. This value is sent in the cargoProviders field.

name.description: Display name of the cargo provider
